intents.text: Add Response.apply_conditions(request, *, exists=True) in wrappers/response.py that evaluates If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since in RFC 9110 order for all methods, treats a star ETag according to `exists`, raises PreconditionFailed on failure, converts satisfied If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since on GET/HEAD to 304 with entity headers removed, and sets Accept-Ranges: bytes.

Add Response.apply_range(request) that applies the Range header after conditions: bytes only, clamps too-large stop/suffix, uses only the first range, raises RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable when unsatisfiable, otherwise produces 206 with sliced data and Content-Range, honoring If-Range via IfRange.check.

Keep Response.make_conditional working but deprecated (DeprecationWarning), implemented via apply_conditions and apply_range; deprecate werkzeug.http.is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid the same way.

Make Range.from_header, Range.make_content_range and ContentRange.from_header validate their own values; make_content_range clamps too-large stop/suffix and uses the first range when several are given.
Add IfRange.check(etag, last_modified) -> bool in datastructures/range.py, true when a strong ETag equals etag or the date equals last_modified.
Make ETagSet.from_header discard invalid unquoted values.

Refactor send_file in utils.py to use apply_conditions/apply_range, detect name, size and mtime from file-like objects when possible, call seek(0) on file-like objects, drop the path hash from the ETag, and default to application/octet-stream when download_name is not given instead of raising.
Make SharedDataMiddleware serve files through send_file, stop setting cache_timeout by default, and deprecate (still accept, with DeprecationWarning) the cache and fallback_mimetype parameters.
Document the new methods in the quickstart docs and add a changelog entry.

Add tests for apply_conditions (each header, methods, star ETag with/without resource, 304 vs 412) and apply_range (first range only, clamping, unsatisfiable, 206 with correct Content-Range); update send_file tests for detection, seek, ETag and mimetype changes; move or remove tests of deprecated functions so `pytest -m "not dev_server"` stays green.

constraints: Leave everything not listed in the request unchanged
Test suite must pass with pytest -m "not dev_server"
